name: scope_presentation
description: Which published presentation_template one account, profile site or organization wears. scope is account (ref is the viewer actor subject, a personal default), profile (ref is the visited site_id) or org (ref is the visited organization key). Resolution is route row, then profile, then org, then account: owner specificity wins and the account row applies only where owners are silent. Presentation only: it reads no subject, grants no action and owns no route.
